response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing')), mix_shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, mix_count::numeric / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM mix_shares QUALIFY share > AVG(share) OVER ()
